market.summary: As of the last close (Friday, Aug 14, 2026), the S&P 500 sits near a fresh record (closed 7,785.76, -0.17% on the day) after topping 7,800 intraday on Aug 13; the index still posted a third straight weekly gain. Nasdaq Composite closed 26,729.16 (-0.28%) and the Dow closed 53,732.41 (-0.20%). The VIX is low at 14.25 (down 2.6% on the day), signaling low near-term fear, but the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.67% (+5bp) alongside firmer oil prices. Friday's pullback followed weaker-than-expected data: University of Michigan preliminary August consumer sentiment fell to 51 (from 55.2, below the 55 forecast) and July retail sales dropped 0.6% m/m, the steepest drop in over a year. The AI trade tone remains constructive but is consolidating into Nvidia's Aug 26 earnings report; commentary highlights hyperscaler AI-capex financing needs (including growing use of private investment-grade debt) as a structural driver for long-duration yields, which is directly relevant to power/AI-infrastructure names. Markets broadly expect the Fed to hold rates steady at the September FOMC meeting.
notes: Key dates in the next ~6 weeks from today (2026-08-15)

Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, Aug 27-29, 2026, hosted by the Kansas City Fed at Jackson Lake Lodge, theme 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy'; Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers the keynote Friday morning Aug 28 (his first Jackson Hole address as chair) -- historically the most market-moving event of the symposium
Nvidia Q2 FY27 earnings, Aug 26, 2026 -- a direct read on AI-infrastructure demand and capex, relevant to the VST/CEG/MSFT/AMZN power-and-AI anchor names
CPI report for August 2026 data, released Sep 11, 2026, 8:30am ET (BLS)
Next FOMC meeting, Sep 15-16, 2026, includes a Summary of Economic Projections (dot plot); the prior meeting (Jul 28-29, 2026) held the target range at 3.5%-3.75%
CPI report for September 2026 data, released Oct 14, 2026
Following FOMC meeting, Oct 27-28, 2026 (just past the 6-week window but flagged for continuity). Any of these can move rates, VIX, and AI-name volatility premia sharply around their dates
